about_the_game:
A comical adult fantasy shooter with a fantasy theme! You take on the role of a female knight and face off against the approaching orc army. Use normal shots and a variety of special bullets to repel the orc army. If you lose to the orcs, you will have to go through humiliating training! However, if you can endure the training, you will power up and become stronger and stronger, so you can defeat the orcs!

  • Character Introduction

    Protagonist: Charlotte von Valenstein, commonly known as Lotti.

    She is a saint who can cast a "barrier" to prevent the invasion of monsters,

    but she is framed by a fellow saint and demoted to a remote area.

    She is extraordinarily stupid and honest, and is so insensitive that she doesn't see any adversity as a problem.

  • Orc:A monster born from the evil that permeates the world.

    After wreaking havoc for hundreds of years, it is finally time to be purified.

    The orcs, seeing potential in Lotti,

    make the unexpected decision to train her and have her purify them.

  • Game Introduction:

    ① An army of orcs will attack from the top of the screen, so fire magic bullets to fight them off.

    ②A magical barrier has been put up along the blue line.If this is destroyed or broken through, you will be defeated.

    ③If she is defeated, the orcs will give her special training to become stronger.

    Lottie's level will increase as she undergoes special training.Can she defeat the orcs and bring peace back to the land?

content_descriptors.notes: There is an erotic depiction in the protagonist's training scene.
